# pushward_org_members (Data Source)

Every member of the organization, by role (owners first), then by when they joined. People with a pending invite are not members yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pushward_org_members" "all" {}

# Everyone with the viewer role, for a read-only group.
resource "pushward_org_group" "auditors" {
  name       = "auditors"
  member_ids = [for m in data.pushward_org_members.all.members : m.user_id if m.role == "viewer"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The member's email label; null when there is none.
- `joined_at` (String) When they joined.
- `nickname` (String) The member's name, if they set one.
- `role` (String) `owner`, `admin`, `billing`, `member` or `viewer`.
- `user_id` (String) User id.
